packageIdentityPolicy: reuse generic linux RID only after evidence; do not create distro-specific NuGet identity during certification

baselineRequirements.dotnet: A supported .NET 8 or .NET 10 runtime/SDK must execute C# consumer code on the target OS; Mono-only or vendor-patched runtime evidence is insufficient
baselineRequirements.native: The native loader, OpenCV shared libraries, and C++ runtime must execute on real target architecture with measured ELF closure
baselineRequirements.evidence: Record OS release, kernel, CPU, libc, OpenSSL/ICU, .NET --info, SDK source/hash, compiler/toolchain, package hashes, and native smoke output
baselineRequirements.runner: QEMU-only evidence is research evidence and cannot promote a platform or package

stopConditions: No supported .NET runtime on the exact release/architecture
native loader or libc symbol closure is not reproducible

promotionPolicy: A certification result may reuse linux-x64 or linux-arm64 only after the matching generic RID preview gate is complete.
Do not add a domestic distro RID or package ID solely because a portable .NET runtime starts.
A platform is real-supported only when runtime, native, headless/desktop scope, and rollback evidence are all classified.
Vendor CPU names do not create a new package architecture; ISA and measured runtime behaviour determine reuse.
